current_f2_source.finding: VoiceOutputPacket permits interrupted playback with a retained heard_fraction but only fully heard completed output may be commit_eligible. This establishes durable/accepted spoken-outcome gating, not next-turn dialogue-context deletion semantics.

Voice contracts are identity/provenance evidence only and explicitly do not mint UnifiedDB write, effect, completion, target-runtime, GRID, GWT or J-Space authority. No explicit interrupted-response next-turn context policy is defined here.

external_primary_evidence.finding: RealtimeSession interruption handling updates history so the server-side conversation stays aligned with what the user actually heard; delayed/remote playback should use playback tracking so truncation reflects actual playback position.
On WebSocket interruption the SDK truncates assistant audio/history to what the user actually heard; local history updates from the corresponding truncation/conversation events.
On interruption LiveKit stops speech and automatically truncates conversation history to include only the portion of agent speech heard before interruption.
Playback-synchronized agent transcription is truncated to match spoken output when interrupted, reinforcing playout-grounded heard-prefix semantics.

research_conclusion.rule: After an interruption, retain exactly the demonstrably heard assistant prefix in ephemeral next-turn dialogue context, exclude the unheard tail, and do not thereby admit any durable memory, effect, completion or whole-product credit.
research_conclusion.heard_boundary_authority: The boundary must be derived from an actual playout/sink receipt or equivalent measured playback position, not from generation completion or caller-supplied belief alone.
research_conclusion.ephemeral_scope: The retained prefix may influence the next effective model turn for conversational coherence only.
research_conclusion.durable_scope: Durable memory and VoiceOutcome/effect admission remain governed by their existing independent authority gates.
research_conclusion.causal_scope: Late writes from the cancelled generation and old-turn tool data must remain fenced and may not regain authority merely because a heard prefix is retained.

why_this_is_now_high_confidence: Current F2 source already separates heard_fraction from commit_eligible state.
Multiple independent current realtime frameworks converge on history aligned to what was actually heard rather than generation-complete text.
The rule avoids both prefix amnesia and unheard-tail leakage while preserving F2 canonical memory/effect boundaries.
